name: Long Video Studio
description: Standalone topic-driven long-form narrated video production by one Long Video Producer. Plans chapters, batches narration, sources economical stills and B-roll, and assembles durable media with video.json progress under assetsRoot/videos/<id> without a series dependency. Provider-neutral: the Studio toolkit decides which configured speech, stock, image and video tools are used. Install the studio-library, video-composer and ffmpeg-guide skill templates first, then assign a provider/model to the agent.
author: AT
